rationale: The agent appears to have executed an exchange without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating policy. The tool call shows both original items exchanged to the same new item (new_item_ids duplicated), which does not match the user’s request for two different replacements. There is no visible confirmation step or summary prior to the write, and the final message provides no details about what was changed, shipping, or payment adjustments. While the agent did attempt to identify the user and access order details, the lack of explicit confirmation and the incorrect mapping of items means the request was not completed in line with policy.
